quest.title: Dwarkanath's White Iron Chunks
quest.description: Dwarkanath from Sumeru City needs five White Iron Chunks.

talks.objective: Give five White Iron Chunks to Dwarkanath

dialogues.speaker: Dwarkanath
dialogues.text: Ah, I remember. Iradj's always losing my knives so I posted the commission.

dialogues.speaker: Dwarkanath
dialogues.text: I guess you've got those five White Iron Chunks?

choices.text: Here are the White Iron Chunks you wanted.

response.speaker: Dwarkanath
response.text: Doesn't hurt to prepare more of that. You can't have enough knives for Iradj to lose. That idiot...

dialogues.speaker: Dwarkanath
dialogues.text: Thank you, I will go to dad later to make a bunch of knives. Can't wait to see Iradj's face when he gets them, haha!
